<style>
  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

  :root {
    --white: #ffffff;
    --off-white: #fafafa;
    --bg: #ffffff;
    --bg-subtle: #f7f7f7;
    --text: #0d0d0d;
    --text-2: #3a3a3a;
    --text-muted: #888;
    --border: #e8e8e8;
    --border-strong: #d0d0d0;
    --dark: #0d0d0d;
    --dark-2: #161616;
    --dark-text-muted: #888;
    --mono: 'Geist Mono', monospace;
    --sans: 'Geist', sans-serif;
  }

  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

  body {
    font-family: var(--sans);
    background: var(--bg);
    color: var(--text);
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    overflow-x: hidden;
  }

  /* ── NAV ── */
  nav {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
    z-index: 100;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 0 48px;
    height: 58px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.92);
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }

  .nav-logo {
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: -0.03em;
    color: var(--text);
    text-decoration: none;
  }

  .nav-links {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 32px;
    list-style: none;
  }

  .nav-links a {
    font-size: 14px;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: color 0.15s;
  }
  .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--text); }

  .nav-right {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .btn-outline {
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--text-2);
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
    border-radius: 7px;
    padding: 7px 16px;
    cursor: pointer;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: border-color 0.15s, color 0.15s;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
  }
  .btn-outline:hover { border-color: #aaa; color: var(--text); }

  .btn-dark {
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #fff;
    background: var(--dark);
    border: none;
    border-radius: 7px;
    padding: 7px 18px;
    cursor: pointer;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: opacity 0.15s;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
  }
  .btn-dark:hover { opacity: 0.8; }

  /* ── HERO ── */
  .hero {
    padding: 100px 48px 60px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 56px;
    align-items: center;
    max-width: 1440px;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  .hero-left { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; }

  .hero-right {
    position: relative;
  }

  .hero-window {
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.09), 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
  }

  .hero-window-bar {
    background: var(--bg-subtle);
    height: 34px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 0 14px;
    gap: 5px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .hw-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; }

  .hero-window-url {
    margin-left: 12px;
    flex: 1;
    background: var(--border);
    border-radius: 5px;
    height: 20px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 0 10px;
    gap: 6px;
  }

  .hero-window-url span {
    font-size: 11px;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    color: var(--text-muted);
  }

  .hero-window img {
    width: 100%;
    display: block;
    /* show top portion of dashboard */
    object-fit: cover;
    object-position: top;
    max-height: 340px;
  }

  /* floating stat cards */
  .hero-float-card {
    position: absolute;
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 12px 16px;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 2px;
    min-width: 130px;
  }

  .hfc-label {
    font-size: 11px;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    color: var(--text-muted);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  }

  .hfc-value {
    font-size: 20px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: -0.03em;
    color: var(--text);
  }

  .hfc-sub {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--text-muted);
  }

  @media (max-width: 900px) {
    .hero {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      padding: 120px 24px 60px;
    }
    .hero-right { display: none; }
  }

  .hero-label {
    font-size: 12px;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    color: var(--text-muted);
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    margin-bottom: 28px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .hero-label::before {
    content: '';
    display: inline-block;
    width: 20px;
    height: 1px;
    background: var(--text-muted);
  }

  .hero h1 {
    font-size: clamp(44px, 5.5vw, 76px);
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: -0.045em;
    line-height: 1.0;
    color: var(--text);
    max-width: 820px;
    text-wrap: balance;
  }

  .hero-sub {
    margin-top: 24px;
    font-size: 18px;
    line-height: 1.65;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    max-width: 500px;
    font-weight: 400;
    text-wrap: pretty;
  }

  .hero-ctas {
    margin-top: 40px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .btn-hero-dark {
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 600;
    padding: 11px 26px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    text-decoration: none;
    background: var(--dark);
    color: #fff;
    border: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: opacity 0.15s;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
  }
  .btn-hero-dark:hover { opacity: 0.8; }

  .btn-hero-outline {
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 500;
    padding: 11px 26px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    text-decoration: none;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--text-2);
    border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: border-color 0.15s, color 0.15s;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
  }
  .btn-hero-outline:hover { border-color: #aaa; color: var(--text); }

  /* ── STATS STRIP ── */
  .stats-strip {
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    padding: 0 48px;
  }

  .stats-inner {
    max-width: 1120px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    display: flex;
    align-items: stretch;
  }

  .stat-item {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 28px 0;
    border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
    padding-right: 40px;
    padding-left: 40px;
  }

  .stat-item:first-child { padding-left: 0; }
  .stat-item:last-child { border-right: none; }

  .stat-val {
    font-size: 30px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: -0.04em;
    color: var(--text);
  }

  .stat-lbl {
    margin-top: 3px;
    font-size: 12.5px;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    font-family: var(--mono);
  }

  /* ── PREVIEW ── */
  .preview-section {
    padding: 40px 24px 60px;
    max-width: 1320px;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  .preview-window {
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
  }

  .preview-titlebar {
    background: var(--bg-subtle);
    height: 38px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 0 16px;
    gap: 6px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }

  function switchTab(name) {

    document.querySelector(`[data-tab="${name}"]`).classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById(`tab-${name}`).classList.add('active');
  }

  function switchSnippet(name) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.code-tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
    document.querySelectorAll('.code-snippet').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('active'));

  }
